items.problem: Bootstrap omitted authored files linked from the UWP csproj, forcing manual reconstruction and secondary XAML/C# build errors.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turns 2-12: bootstrap reported only 3 files; the UWP project linked App.xaml(.cs), MainPage.xaml(.cs), Styles.xaml, and assets; turns 14-18 then hit CS1503, WMC0001, WMC0909/WMC1111/WMC9999, and NETSDK1022.
items.skill_search: Searched Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 for Link, SharedContent, ApplicationDefinition, Page Include, and Compile Include; no linked-item handling existed.
items.root_cause: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 recursively copied only below -Source even though legacy UWP projects commonly use external linked project items.
items.proposed_fix: Teach bootstrap to resolve common project properties and copy linked Compile/Page/ApplicationDefinition/Content items to their Link paths before triage.
items.generalizes: UWP SDK samples and multi-project apps routinely share shells, resource dictionaries, helpers, and assets through linked MSBuild items.

items.problem: The skill instructed the agent to compile with a nonexistent winapp build command.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turn 13: WinApp CLI returned 'build was not matched' and listed no build command.
items.skill_search: Searched SKILL.md and MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md for 'winapp build'; SKILL.md prescribed it in Step 3 and after validation.
items.wrong_text_if_any: Prefer `winapp build` to compile; After PASS, do a final `winapp build`.
items.root_cause: The workflow conflated WinApp CLI launch/identity responsibilities with native .NET compilation.
items.proposed_fix: Replace compile guidance with synchronous dotnet build commands and remove residual wording that names winapp build.
items.generalizes: Every C# WinUI 3 migration needs a reliable compile command, independent of which WinApp CLI version is installed.

items.problem: Test-AppLaunch.ps1 could not discover output produced by a normal unqualified dotnet build.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turn 19: status=unavailable because no output was found under bin\x64\Debug, while turn 18 built successfully to bin\Debug\net10.0-windows10.0.26100.0\win-x64.
items.skill_search: Searched Test-AppLaunch.ps1 for bin output discovery; candidates included only bin\<arch>\Debug and bin\<rid>\Debug.
items.wrong_text_if_any: The build-output layout is discovered under bin/<arch>/Debug/<tfm>/win-<rid>.
items.root_cause: The script assumed Platform-qualified output even though SKILL.md also allowed ordinary dotnet build.
items.proposed_fix: Add bin\Debug as a candidate while retaining platform-qualified candidates.
items.generalizes: SDK-style .NET projects commonly emit either qualified or unqualified output depending on whether Platform was passed.
